entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and perhaps the most talented mind mage in the Multiverse, able to read thoughts, erase memories, induce sleep and create illusions.

events.summary: For many years Jace had no memory of his childhood; those memories are now restored.
events.quote: For many years, Jace had no memory of his childhood. Although those memories are now restored

events.summary: Jace chooses not to read the true intentions of those around him so as not to erode his friends' trust.
events.quote: Jace could easily read the true intentions of those around him, but he recognizes that doing so would erode the trust of his friends
